items.title: A.B. Spellman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 19, 2022
items.q: People like Vijay Iyer I think brought some newer stuff to it.

ctx.x: Yeah it’s a little stunning to think how many years ago it was that some of this incredible experimentation was going on in jazz.

Well they tell me that there’s great experimentation going on now but I don’t really hear a lot of it. People like Vijay Iyer I think brought some newer stuff to it. It’s always interesting how people can come from other cultures and bring those cultures into jazz. It’s the great thing about jazz that it can settle almost anywhere and pick up on whatever the rhythms and harmonies and lines of that culture are and it can work in with the music. I remember just after apartheid fell and I was at the association —…

I’ve often felt that America’s greatest export has been its music. If you go around the world that jazz is in every continent and of course our rock & roll and hip hop now is pretty much heard everywhere.
